contentBlocks.text: ਇਸ ਹਫ਼ਤੇ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਬਹੁਤ ਕੁਝ ਲਿਖਿਆ! (This week you wrote so much!) Let's review all the new words and combine everything into one complete piece about your life.

Quick review: family words ਪਰਿਵਾਰ/ਦਾਦਾ ਜੀ/ਦਾਦੀ ਜੀ/ਨਾਨਾ ਜੀ/ਨਾਨੀ ਜੀ/ਭੈਣ/ਭਰਾ (Days 1-2), daily routine words ਸਵੇਰ/ਦਿਨ/ਜਾਣਾ (Day 3), and celebration words ਤਿਉਹਾਰ/ਖੁਸ਼ੀ/ਮਨਾਉਣਾ (Day 4). Now gather your sentences from all four days and combine them into one complete paragraph about your life: your family, your daily routine, and a favorite tradition. Read your finished paragraph aloud.
ਸ਼ਾਬਾਸ਼! (Well done!) You just wrote a complete, real paragraph about your own life in Punjabi, using vocabulary and structure from every day this week.

objectives: Recall all 10 new vocabulary words learned this week
Combine the week's separate writing pieces into one complete paragraph about their own life
teacherGuide.facilitationScript:
1. Do the quick walk-through vocabulary review of all 4 days together, out loud.
2. Have the child gather and combine their sentences from Days 1, 3, and 4 into one finished paragraph.
3. Read the finished paragraph aloud together.
4. Complete the cumulative review worksheet.
5. Celebrate finishing a real, complete piece of personal writing in Punjabi.
differentiationTips: Struggling: allow the child to keep the paragraph as 3-4 separate but related sentences rather than requiring smooth transitions between them
Ready for more: ask them to add one transition word (like yesterday's ਅਤੇ 'and' or a new connector) between two of the sentences
This is a genuine finished-writing milestone — treat it as something worth celebrating, matching the ELA course's own end-of-week paragraph synthesis
teacherGuide.answerKey: 1. ਨਾਨਾ ਜੀ = maternal grandfather. 2. ਸਵੇਰ = morning. 3. ਤਿਉਹਾਰ = festival/celebration. 4. ਭੈਣ = sister.
teacherGuide.standardsRationale: Consolidates the week's vocabulary-expansion and paragraph-writing goals into one complete piece of personal, cultural writing, matching the course's own 'paragraph writing, vocabulary expansion, and cultural stories' description end to end.
